final: WITH customer_orders AS (SELECT o.customer_id, c.gender, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM Orders AS o JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY o.customer_id, c.gender), gender_totals AS (SELECT gender, SUM(order_count) AS total_orders FROM customer_orders GROUP BY gender), shares AS (SELECT co.customer_id, co.gender, co.order_count, CAST(co.order_count AS REAL) / gt.total_orders AS share FROM customer_orders AS co JOIN gender_totals AS gt ON co.gender = gt.gender), overall AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT s.customer_id, s.gender, s.order_count, s.share, s.share - o.average_share AS difference FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.average_share IS NOT NULL AND s.share > o.average_share ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
